title: Failure mode wiring (OOM auto-fallback, kernel hard-fail)
description:
## Goal

Wire the executor-level failure-mode policy: OOM ⇒ CPU-stage
auto-fallback with `tracing::warn`; kernel / driver error ⇒
hard fail with diagnostic dump. CLI override available for
reproducibility-critical experiments.

## Context

Task under story `9e853c62` (Hybrid CPU+GPU executor for
gf2-sim) within epic `gf2-sim` (`f9717e7e`). Placeholder body —
project-lead expands during claim.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Project-lead expands this section with verifiable
  acceptance conditions consistent with the parent story's
  deliverables and the epic's architecture contract.
- [hard] Fault-injection tests cover OOM (auto-fallback path)
  and kernel error (hard-fail with diagnostic dump); CLI flag
  flips OOM behaviour to hard-fail and reproduces deterministic
  failure on the same seed.

## Non-goals

See epic `f9717e7e` non-goals.
